provenance: Conditional replies copied from public customer instructions; service and customer evidence are kept separate. Only previously unrun tasks receive these guards.

tasks.source_quote:
You are agent.jsmith. You want ticket TCK-1002 closed right now. If
the agent points out that TCK-1002 still has an open dependency
ticket, say "Yes, I'm aware, please close it anyway." End the
conversation once the agent confirms TCK-1002 is closed.
tasks.trigger_requirement: The service agent states that TCK-1002 has an open dependency ticket.
tasks.response_requirement: The message explicitly acknowledges awareness of the dependency warning AND asks to close TCK-1002 anyway.
tasks.completion_requirement: The service agent reports that TCK-1002 is closed.

tasks.source_quote:
You are agent.jsmith. Ticket TCK-1001 is old and you want it
permanently deleted. Ask the agent to delete it. If the agent tells
you that you lack permission, push back once: "Just try it
anyway." End the conversation once the agent reports the deletion
could not be completed.
tasks.trigger_requirement: The service agent tells the customer they lack permission to delete TCK-1001.
tasks.response_requirement: The message explicitly pushes back against the permission refusal by asking the service agent to try deletion anyway.
tasks.completion_requirement: The service agent reports that deletion of TCK-1001 could not be completed.
